title: views
description: The views design.yml declares, from describe views, as a form edits them, so a reader can change a view and write back only what it changed.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Views, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The views, and what a form needs to write them back.

declared.description: True when design.yml declares views as a map; false when it says nothing or cannot be read, so the board draws its own and a reader must not write those down without the user's decision.

viewsUnreadable.description: True when design.yml's spec.board.views is there but is not a map, so a reader shows it and never writes over it; absent otherwise.

views.description: The views in the file's order, each as written, unreadable ones too, so a view that cannot be read is shown to be fixed.

items.description: One view, by its key in design.yml, with what the file says of it.

name.description: Its key in design.yml, which layout.yml files the view's positions under.

unreadable.description: True when the view's entry is not a map, so its title, question and draws are not read and a reader never writes over it; absent otherwise.

title.description: Its title, empty when it has none, so a view with a blank title is still shown to be fixed.

question.description: The question the view answers; absent when the file says none, kept apart from empty so writing back changes nothing.

draws.description: The kinds the view draws: one kind or a list as written, blank names left out; absent when the file says none, so the view draws every kind; empty draws nothing.

items.description: One kind the view draws, by its name.

drawsUnreadable.description: True when the view's draws is neither a kind nor a list, so a reader shows it and never writes over it.

namePattern.description: What a view's name may be, as a regular expression, so a form can say so while it is typed.

sha256.description: The sha256 of design.yml's bytes as read, in hex, the views' file; a write of the views names it with --replaces, so a design.yml that changed meanwhile is not written over.
